card.title: How to Fix an iPad Pro 10.5 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How to Fix an iPad Pro 10.5 That Randomly Restarts

symptoms: restarts every 60 seconds after screen repair

claims.statement: On iPad Pro 10.5 random restarts, look in the panic-full log for a thermalmonitord check-in failure listing missing sensors.
Missing sensor TG0B points to the battery or its connector (check the battery screw is tight and connector pins are intact).
A defective display can make the iPad restart about every 60 seconds even if it appears to work.
With no panic log, inspect coils around the PMIC for missing or loose parts; they should not move when pushed sideways.

procedure: Open the latest panic-full log and find the missing sensors list.
TG0B: tighten battery screw, inspect connector, try known-good battery.
If no panic logs, inspect and push-test coils around the PMIC; replace loose ones.
card.caveats: The display's sensor code is not identified on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
